title: Per-splice golden-delay completions including the splice at one

correction.previousOmission: the per-splice model began at 10 and omitted TTI's splice at 1
correction.unresolvedIndexing: TTI does not yet specify whether the splice at 1 is a zeroth seed, the first Fibonacci cohort, or a carrier-free boundary, so all three readings are tested

verdict.conclusion: all three coherent treatments of the splice at 1 yield entire, symmetry-preserving finite theta completions. Under both tested clock schedules each model has only critical-line zeros through height 30 at the selected stages. The indexing changes carrier counts and ordinates but does not remove the escaping-quartet obstruction to a global shrinking strip.

delayLaw.remainingGap: g_(ell,k)=phi^(-(d_ell+k_ell)), where d_ell depends on the indexing model

zerothSeed.description: level 0 at x=1 has one seed carrier with d_0=0; levels ell>=1 keep cohort F_ell and depth index d_ell=ell

reindexedFibonacci.description: level ell receives cohort F_(ell+1) and depth index d_ell=ell+1, so x=1 is the first Fibonacci splice and every later label shifts

boundaryOnly.description: x=1 has a geometric delay with d_0=0 but no theta carrier; levels ell>=1 retain the published F_ell cohorts
boundaryOnly.analyticConsequence: without a coupling or carrier, the x=1 boundary does not alter the zeros

finiteCompletion.delayedThetaCarrier: Psi_(N,k)(x)=sum_over_active_cohorts [1-phi^(-(d_ell+k_ell))] sum_(m in B_ell) exp(-pi m^2 x)
finiteCompletion.limit: as the decimal cutoff tends to infinity and every fixed carrier-bearing cohort clock tends to infinity, every fixed theta coefficient tends to one and Xi_(N,k) tends locally uniformly to xi
finiteCompletion.numericalMethod: 256-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature in u=log x on [0,6]

testedSchedules.chronological: k_ell=N-ell. Zeroth-seed and boundary models synchronise carrier gaps to phi^(-N); the reindexed model synchronises them to phi^(-(N+1)).
testedSchedules.equalLocalTicks: k_ell=N. Initial depths remain visible, producing distinct gaps within each carrier-bearing model.

properties: P_N tends to one locally at order phi^(-2N), so hat_Xi_N has the same locally uniform xi limit
each stage has an off-line quartet with |eta|=1/4 at height phi^N
stressFamily.consequence: including the splice at 1, under any of the three indexing conventions, does not imply a global shrinking zero strip

logicalAssessment.sufficientTheorem: if a selected indexing and clock schedule gives local convergence and every stage zero obeys a shrinking bound with no escaping quartets, then Rouche/Hurwitz forces RH
missingConditions: a TTI rule choosing among the three splice-at-one indexing models
a derived relation between every local clock and the global cutoff
a global zero count matching xi rather than fixed-height counts
an exclusion of escaping off-line quartets at heights growing with the cutoff
logicalAssessment.status: the splice at 1 changes the finite bookkeeping but does not establish the global bound
